78065.subject: Core Lightning Tells Node Operators to Go Offline
78065.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Core Lightning](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/core-lightning-tells-node-operators-to-go-offline-with-no-patch-published)**[ tells node operators to shut down, with no patch published](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/core-lightning-tells-node-operators-to-go-offline-with-no-patch-published)

* **[Unstoppable](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/unstoppable-skips-icann-round-refunds-web3-domains)**[ skips the ICANN round and refunds web3 domains](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/unstoppable-skips-icann-round-refunds-web3-domains)

* **[39 state banking groups](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/39-state-banking-groups-form-bankchain-alliance-for-2027-blockchain-launch)**[ form BankChain Alliance for a 2027 launch](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/39-state-banking-groups-form-bankchain-alliance-for-2027-blockchain-launch)

* **[Revolut](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/revolut-starts-eurr-rollout-with-bridge-as-regulated-issuer)**[ starts its EURR rollout with €374 outstanding](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/revolut-starts-eurr-rollout-with-bridge-as-regulated-issuer)

* **[Aave](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-opens-ios-early-access-keeps-android-and-web-waitlisted)**[ opens iOS early access and keeps Android and web waitlisted](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-opens-ios-early-access-keeps-android-and-web-waitlisted)

Core Lightning's maintainers told node operators on Wednesday to take their nodes offline unless they upgrade to a release that has not been published. The binaries were not out as of Wednesday afternoon, and what they fix sits under a two-week embargo.

The guidance [circulated in the project's Discord and reached the network through third parties.](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/core-lightning-tells-node-operators-to-go-offline-with-no-patch-published) Mark Erhardt, a Bitcoin Core contributor at Localhost Research, confirmed with a maintainer that it was real. Cashu developer Calle then amplified it with sharper framing than the original text carries, calling it a critical vulnerability and telling users to shut down right now. The Core Lightning message does not use the word critical, describe a single vulnerability, or say to shut down immediately.

Core Lightning runs a share of a network carrying about 3,750 BTC across 33,101 channels. The newest tagged release is v26.06.6 from July 22, and the project's security advisories page lists none. This is the fourth Bitcoin infrastructure alarm in four weeks, after the Coldcard firmware bug, the Boltz shutdown and the BTCPay Server flaw.

**Read more below!**

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!

Yours faithfully
